description: This file defines the ReportingMethodModel class in the OrangeHRM application, which implements the Normalizable interface and uses traits for serialization. It encapsulates a ReportingMethod entity and provides methods for setting entity data, filters, and attribute names, serving as a model for reporting methods within the HRM system.

classes.name: ReportingMethodModel
classes.description: A model class representing reporting methods, used for serialization and data handling within the system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a ReportingMethod entity, setting filters and attribute mappings.
